description: When a call fails with a daily-limit error, or your operator asks what alalanet costs. No arguments; changes and costs nothing, and answers also when the quota is used up. Returns the free limits (checks and live checks per day per client), each paid plan (id, USD price for 30 days, daily limits, watched services) and the payment networks with their coin (USDC on Base, USDT elsewhere), token contract and receiving address. A plan id goes to create_invoice; buying a plan is a spend for the user to approve. Without a plan: $0.002 per live check over x402 at /x402/check?url=<endpoint> on this server (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; the pay_per_call object comes with the quota error).
name: list_plans
title: Plans and payment networks
